title: DataTable
responsibility: Frames caller-owned table rows in a labelled keyboard-scrollable region without loading or transforming data.

inputs.name: DataTable.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name for both the table and its scroll region.

inputs.name: DataTable.header
inputs.description: Required snippet of header rows and scoped column headings.

inputs.name: DataTable.children
inputs.description: Required snippet of body rows; the caller retains data ordering, cell formatting and actions.

inputs.name: DataTable.empty
inputs.description: Optional snippet of complete empty rows and cell spans; omitted empty content renders no body rows.

inputs.name: DataTable.isEmpty
inputs.description: Optional empty-state selector, default false. True renders empty instead of children.

inputs.name: DataTable.className
inputs.description: Optional frame classes, default an empty string; feature styling stays with the caller.

inputs.name: DataTable.tableClass
inputs.description: Optional table classes, default an empty string; existing catalog styles remain supported.

outputs.name: DataTable
outputs.description: A semantic table with caller-provided header/body or empty rows, contained horizontal scrolling and a keyboard-focusable labelled region.

errors.name: Caller content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied snippets propagate; this presentation component does not catch them.
